scenes.headline: Hook: The heavy promise
scenes.narration: You promised yourself you would read thirty pages tonight. The book is right there, but your mind treats the goal like another impossible assignment.

scenes.headline: The Two Minute Rule
scenes.narration: In Atomic Habits, James Clear explains the Two Minute Rule. Make the beginning of a new habit take less than two minutes. Forget the thirty pages for now.

scenes.headline: A physical demonstration
scenes.narration: Watch this. Close the sprawling reading plan, put your phone face down, open the book, and read just one page. The first action is small, but real.

scenes.headline: Payoff: Show up tomorrow
scenes.narration: Tomorrow, repeat that tiny start before deciding whether to continue. You are not trying to finish a book tonight. You are practicing becoming someone who begins.
